DACA recipients are experiencing major delays in renewing their status. As a result, people are losing their jobs and facing detention and removal.

This is unacceptable. I’m joining @RepChuyGarcia and @RepLouCorrea to demand answers from DHS. notus.org/immigration/daca-r…

People are paying more for their health insurance premiums because Republicans refused to extend the ACA tax credits.

We need to restore these credits to relieve the immediate pain, and we need Medicare for All.

Video

This is unfortunately the same story over and over again of powerful men who think they can get away with anything, including assaulting women. We have to make it completely clear that this is unacceptable at any level from anyone, including those who hold tremendous responsibility and power.
Rep. Swalwell should immediately withdraw from the governor’s race and there must be a quick and thorough investigation.

I am horrified to learn about the allegations made by multiple women against Eric Swalwell. My heart goes out to these brave women who have suffered with this secret, thought it was just them,  and now have courageously come forward—all sharing similar patterns of assault—to demand accountability.

Last night, I hosted my 130th town hall since coming to Congress. So many people showed up to ask questions and share their concerns about Trump’s authoritarian attacks.

It is so important that we come together in community during this current moment and chart a path forward.

Section 702 of the Foreign Intelligence Surveillance Act is a powerful tool the government uses to surveil Americans without a warrant — and it has a troubling history of misuse.

Check out my op-ed on why Congress must not reauthorize it without real reforms and protections. thehill.com/opinion/congress…

Biggest increase in inflation in 4 years.
Biggest monthly increase in gas prices in 60 years.

Trump’s war in Iran is costing Americans big here at home.

TONIGHT: I’m hosting my 130th town hall! If you’re not able to join in person, tune in live!

I met with one of my constituents who bravely served in Afghanistan, and he did me the incredible honor of presenting me with his ribbon rack.

He and the people he served with have seen forever wars their entire lives. It is time for these needless, thoughtless wars to end.

Video

Since the war against Iran began, hundreds of civilians in Lebanon have been killed and injured, and over a million people have been displaced. Israel has also signaled plans to occupy much of southern Lebanon.

This cannot continue — civilians must be protected, civilian infrastructure should not be targeted, and we must stop any Israeli occupation of Lebanon.


ABC News (@ABC)

At least 254 people have been killed and another 1,165 have been injured in Israeli attacks across Lebanon on Wednesd

Donald Trump has launched us into an illegal, unauthorized war in Iran, and just two days ago, he threatened to end an entire civilization.

His unhinged, dangerous threats show once again how unfit he is to be president. He must be removed from office now.

Video

The war in Iran has gone on too long — and should have never started in the first place.

Congress must immediately vote on another War Powers Resolution.

Video

This illegal war must end. And Donald Trump needs to be removed from office.

Video

Thousands of Iranian and Lebanese civilians have been killed, millions more displaced. U.S. servicemembers' lives are being put in danger. And Americans are paying the price at the gas pump. 

Congress must vote on a War Powers Resolution to end Trump’s illegal war now.

Video

ICYMI: I reintroduced the Ultra-Millionaire Tax Act.

If billionaires paid their fair share, we could pay for community college for every American, expand health care access, and reinvest in the American people.

Paramount Skydance is trying to buy Warner Brother Discovery for $110 BILLION, which would give massive media control to one giant company run by a major Trump supporter. It also means less choices and higher costs for you.

We need to stand up to this corporate consolidation.

Video

I’m relieved Trump did not destroy an entire civilization last night, but his unhinged threat and illegal war make it clear he is unfit to serve as president.

Trump needs to be removed from office. And we must oppose his new $1.5 trillion budget proposal for more war.

Trump is threatening war crimes, which could lead to untold destruction in Iran. And here at home, prices are spiking and will continue to go up.

The American people do not want this.

Video
